# For 1981: (start: 300 + end: 269) / 2 = 284.5

avg_1980 = (352 + 300) / 2

print(f"Average amount outstanding 1981: {avg_1981}")

# Redemptions
red_1980 = 71  # million dollars

# Redemption rate = redemptions / average amount outstanding * 100
rate_1980 = (red_1980 / avg_1980) * 100
rate_1981 = (red_1981 / avg_1981) * 100

print(f"Redemption rate 1980: {rate_1980:.2f}%")
print(f"Redemption rate 1981: {rate_1981:.2f}%")

# Relative difference in percentage points
diff = rate_1981 - rate_1980
